arguments.query: SELECT order_ts, status FROM orders LIMIT 3

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) q FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND p.is_active=1 AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')>='2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')<'2025-04-01' GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 5
